title: DeployPlan
description: The Maker plan artifact (borrowed from Clanker pattern). Generated by `clawops plan`, applied by `clawops apply`. Reviewable, diff-able, version-controllable.

generator.description: Tool that produced this plan; agents can identify themselves here

stackVersion.description: Pulumi stack version at plan generation time (from UpdateSummary.version). Compared at apply time to detect drift. Absent for new stacks with no history.

region.description: Cloud region. Required for non-local providers

instanceType.description: Provider-native instance type. Adapter normalizes from clawops alias before plan emission

config.description: Overrides applied on top of default openclaw.json. Secrets must use $secret references, never inline values

channels.description: OpenClaw channel integrations keyed by provider name (e.g. {"discord":{"botToken":"..."}}). Values are provider-specific config objects. Sensitive fields must use $secret references.

ref.description: Source-specific reference (env var name, ARN, secret URI, file path)

allowedSshCidrs.description: Empty array = no SSH access (unusual but allowed). Defaults applied at plan generation, not in schema

allowedGatewayCidrs.description: CIDRs allowed to reach the gateway port. Only meaningful with publishGateway "all" — under "loopback" nothing listens on a routable interface, so these rules would admit traffic to a closed port. clawops refuses that combination rather than creating rules that do nothing.

gatewayPort.description: Host port the gateway is published on. Carried in the plan so the firewall rules, the container publish flag, the startup config and the gateway URL all come from one place; it used to be a constant redeclared in six files, which made a port change a six-file edit that could half-apply.

tailscale.description: Optional Tailscale sidecar (borrowed pattern from schmitthub)

authKeyRef.description: Reference to a secret containing the Tailscale auth key

publishGateway.description: Which interface the gateway container publishes on. "loopback" (default) binds 127.0.0.1 on the host, so the gateway is reachable only via `clawops tunnel` or a reverse proxy running on that host. "all" binds 0.0.0.0. Deliberately separate from allowedGatewayCidrs: a firewall rule says who may connect, this says whether the port is listening at all, and exposure should be an explicit choice rather than inherited from a CIDR chosen for SSH. "all" serves plaintext HTTP unless you front it with TLS.

publicKey.description: Public key contents (safe to inline). Private key never in plan

tags.description: Cloud-resource tags propagated to all created resources

diff.description: Optional resource diff populated by `clawops plan` for human review. Not used by `apply`
